package domain

import (
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type LearningGoal struct {
	Code         string `json:"code"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	Title        string `json:"title"`
	Description  string `json:"description"`
	GraphVersion string `json:"graph_version"`
}

type LearningTarget struct {
	Ref           TargetRef   `json:"ref"`
	Title         string      `json:"title"`
	Description   string      `json:"description"`
	Prerequisites []TargetRef `json:"prerequisites"`
	ModuleCode    string      `json:"module_code"`
	ModuleTitle   string      `json:"module_title"`
	ModuleOrder   int         `json:"module_order"`
	SectionCode   string      `json:"section_code"`
	SectionTitle  string      `json:"section_title"`
	SectionOrder  int         `json:"section_order"`
	LessonCode    string      `json:"lesson_code"`
	LessonTitle   string      `json:"lesson_title"`
	LessonExcerpt string      `json:"lesson_excerpt"`
	LessonOrder   int         `json:"lesson_order"`
}

type TransitionKnowledge struct {
	SourceStack     string    `json:"source_stack"`
	Target          TargetRef `json:"target"`
	Similarity      string    `json:"similarity"`
	Difference      string    `json:"difference"`
	AnalogyBoundary string    `json:"analogy_boundary"`
	CommonMistakes  []string  `json:"common_mistakes"`
}

type GoalGraph struct {
	Goal        LearningGoal          `json:"goal"`
	Targets     []LearningTarget      `json:"targets"`
	Transitions []TransitionKnowledge `json:"transitions"`
}

func NormalizeGoalGraph(input GoalGraph) (GoalGraph, error) {
	input.Goal.Code = normalizeCode(input.Goal.Code)
	input.Goal.Version = normalizeCode(input.Goal.Version)
	input.Goal.GraphVersion = normalizeCode(input.Goal.GraphVersion)
	input.Goal.Title = strings.TrimSpace(input.Goal.Title)
	input.Goal.Description = strings.TrimSpace(input.Goal.Description)
	if input.Goal.Code == "" || input.Goal.Version == "" || input.Goal.GraphVersion == "" ||
		input.Goal.Title == "" || len(input.Targets) == 0 || len(input.Targets) > 500 {
		return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
	}
	seenTargets := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Targets))
	type placement struct {
		title   string
		excerpt string
		order   int
	}
	modules := make(map[string]placement)
	moduleOrders := make(map[int]string)
	sections := make(map[string]placement)
	sectionOrders := make(map[string]string)
	lessons := make(map[string]placement)
	lessonOrders := make(map[string]string)
	for index := range input.Targets {
		target := &input.Targets[index]
		ref, err := NormalizeTargetRef(target.Ref)
		prerequisites, prerequisitesErr := NormalizeTargetRefs(target.Prerequisites)
		target.Title = strings.TrimSpace(target.Title)
		target.Description = strings.TrimSpace(target.Description)
		target.ModuleCode = normalizeCode(target.ModuleCode)
		target.ModuleTitle = strings.TrimSpace(target.ModuleTitle)
		target.SectionCode = normalizeCode(target.SectionCode)
		target.SectionTitle = strings.TrimSpace(target.SectionTitle)
		target.LessonCode = normalizeCode(target.LessonCode)
		target.LessonTitle = strings.TrimSpace(target.LessonTitle)
		target.LessonExcerpt = strings.TrimSpace(target.LessonExcerpt)
		if err != nil || prerequisitesErr != nil || target.Title == "" || target.ModuleCode == "" ||
			target.ModuleTitle == "" || target.SectionCode == "" || target.SectionTitle == "" ||
			target.LessonCode == "" || target.LessonTitle == "" || target.ModuleOrder < 0 ||
			target.SectionOrder < 0 || target.LessonOrder < 0 {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		identity := TargetIdentity(ref)
		if _, duplicate := seenTargets[identity]; duplicate {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		module := placement{title: target.ModuleTitle, order: target.ModuleOrder}
		if existing, exists := modules[target.ModuleCode]; exists && existing != module {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if existing, exists := moduleOrders[target.ModuleOrder]; exists && existing != target.ModuleCode {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		modules[target.ModuleCode] = module
		moduleOrders[target.ModuleOrder] = target.ModuleCode

		sectionIdentity := target.ModuleCode + "\x00" + target.SectionCode
		section := placement{title: target.SectionTitle, order: target.SectionOrder}
		if existing, exists := sections[sectionIdentity]; exists && existing != section {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		sectionOrderIdentity := target.ModuleCode + "\x00" + strconv.Itoa(target.SectionOrder)
		if existing, exists := sectionOrders[sectionOrderIdentity]; exists && existing != target.SectionCode {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		sections[sectionIdentity] = section
		sectionOrders[sectionOrderIdentity] = target.SectionCode

		lessonIdentity := sectionIdentity + "\x00" + target.LessonCode
		lesson := placement{title: target.LessonTitle, excerpt: target.LessonExcerpt, order: target.LessonOrder}
		if existing, exists := lessons[lessonIdentity]; exists && existing != lesson {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		lessonOrderIdentity := sectionIdentity + "\x00" + strconv.Itoa(target.LessonOrder)
		if existing, exists := lessonOrders[lessonOrderIdentity]; exists && existing != target.LessonCode {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		lessons[lessonIdentity] = lesson
		lessonOrders[lessonOrderIdentity] = target.LessonCode
		seenTargets[identity] = struct{}{}
		target.Ref = ref
		target.Prerequisites = prerequisites
	}
	seenTransitions := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Transitions))
	for index := range input.Transitions {
		transition := &input.Transitions[index]
		transition.SourceStack = normalizeCode(transition.SourceStack)
		ref, err := NormalizeTargetRef(transition.Target)
		transition.Similarity = strings.TrimSpace(transition.Similarity)
		transition.Difference = strings.TrimSpace(transition.Difference)
		transition.AnalogyBoundary = strings.TrimSpace(transition.AnalogyBoundary)
		if err != nil || transition.SourceStack == "" || transition.Similarity == "" ||
			transition.Difference == "" || transition.AnalogyBoundary == "" {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seenTargets[TargetIdentity(ref)]; !exists {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		identity := transition.SourceStack + "\x00" + TargetIdentity(ref)
		if _, duplicate := seenTransitions[identity]; duplicate {
			return GoalGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		seenTransitions[identity] = struct{}{}
		transition.Target = ref
		transition.CommonMistakes = normalizeTextList(transition.CommonMistakes)
	}
	if _, err := OrderGoalTargets(input.Targets); err != nil {
		return GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	return input, nil
}

// OrderGoalTargets validates that every prerequisite is internal to the goal,
// rejects self-edges and cycles, and returns the stable graph order used by all
// Planner read and Course-planning flows.
func OrderGoalTargets(inputs []LearningTarget) ([]LearningTarget, error) {
	byID := make(map[string]LearningTarget, len(inputs))
	indegree := make(map[string]int, len(inputs))
	dependents := make(map[string][]string, len(inputs))
	for _, input := range inputs {
		identity := TargetIdentity(input.Ref)
		if _, duplicate := byID[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		byID[identity] = input
		indegree[identity] = 0
	}
	for _, input := range inputs {
		identity := TargetIdentity(input.Ref)
		for _, prerequisite := range input.Prerequisites {
			prerequisiteID := TargetIdentity(prerequisite)
			if _, exists := byID[prerequisiteID]; !exists || prerequisiteID == identity {
				return nil, ErrValidation
			}
			indegree[identity]++
			dependents[prerequisiteID] = append(dependents[prerequisiteID], identity)
		}
	}
	ready := make([]string, 0, len(inputs))
	for identity, degree := range indegree {
		if degree == 0 {
			ready = append(ready, identity)
		}
	}
	orderGoalTargetIdentities(ready, byID)
	result := make([]LearningTarget, 0, len(inputs))
	for len(ready) > 0 {
		identity := ready[0]
		ready = ready[1:]
		result = append(result, byID[identity])
		for _, dependent := range dependents[identity] {
			indegree[dependent]--
			if indegree[dependent] == 0 {
				ready = append(ready, dependent)
				orderGoalTargetIdentities(ready, byID)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(result) != len(inputs) {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

func orderGoalTargetIdentities(identities []string, targets map[string]LearningTarget) {
	sort.Slice(identities, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftTarget, rightTarget := targets[identities[left]], targets[identities[right]]
		if leftTarget.ModuleOrder != rightTarget.ModuleOrder {
			return leftTarget.ModuleOrder < rightTarget.ModuleOrder
		}
		if leftTarget.SectionOrder != rightTarget.SectionOrder {
			return leftTarget.SectionOrder < rightTarget.SectionOrder
		}
		if leftTarget.LessonOrder != rightTarget.LessonOrder {
			return leftTarget.LessonOrder < rightTarget.LessonOrder
		}
		return identities[left] < identities[right]
	})
}

func normalizeTextList(inputs []string) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, len(inputs))
	for _, input := range inputs {
		if normalized := strings.TrimSpace(input); normalized != "" {
			result = append(result, normalized)
		}
	}
	return result
}
